shortDescription: Manage L3Out BGP Peer on Cisco Nexus Dashboard Orchestrator (NDO).

options.name: address_families
options.description: The address family controls for the BGP peer.

options.name: admin_state
options.description: The administrative state of the L3Out BGP Peer. Defaults to C(enabled) when unset during creation.

options.name: allowed_self_as_count
options.description: The allowed self-AS count of the L3Out BGP Peer. Defaults to 3 when unset during creation. The value must be between 1 and 10.

options.name: auth_password
options.description: The authentication password of the L3Out BGP Peer.

options.name: bgp_controls
options.description: The BGP control settings for the peer.

options.name: ebgp_multi_hop_ttl
options.description: The TTL for eBGP multi-hop of the L3Out BGP Peer. Defaults to 1 when unset during creation. The value must be between 1 and 255.

options.name: encapsulation_type
options.description: The encapsulation type of the interface.

options.name: encapsulation_value
options.description: The encapsulation value of the interface. The option O(encapsulation_type=vlan), specifies VLAN ID which must be in the range 1 - 4094. The option O(encapsulation_type=vxlan), specifies VXLAN Network Identifier (VNI) which must be in the range 5000 - 16777215.

options.name: export_route_map
options.description: The name of the export route map. Providing an empty dictionary will remove the O(export_route_map={}) from the L3Out BGP Peer. This parameter can be used instead of O(export_route_map_uuid).

options.name: export_route_map_uuid
options.description: The UUID of the export route map. Providing an empty string will remove the O(export_route_map_uuid="") from the L3Out BGP Peer. This parameter can be used instead of O(export_route_map).

options.name: host
options.description: IP Address or hostname of the ACI Multi Site Orchestrator host. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: import_route_map
options.description: The name of the import route map. Providing an empty dictionary will remove the O(import_route_map={}) from the L3Out BGP Peer. This parameter can be used instead of O(import_route_map_uuid).

options.name: import_route_map_uuid
options.description: The UUID of the import route map. Providing an empty string will remove the O(import_route_map_uuid="") from the L3Out BGP Peer. This parameter can be used instead of O(import_route_map).

options.name: ipv4_address
options.description: The IPv4 address of the L3Out BGP Peer. Providing an empty string will remove the O(ipv4_address="") from the L3Out BGP Peer.

options.name: ipv6_address
options.description: The IPv6 address of the L3Out BGP Peer. Providing an empty string will remove the O(ipv6_address="") from the L3Out BGP Peer.

options.name: l3out
options.description: The name of the L3Out. This parameter or O(l3out_uuid) is required.

options.name: l3out_uuid
options.description: The UUID of the L3Out. This parameter or O(l3out) is required.

options.name: local_asn
options.description: The local autonomous system number (ASN) of the L3Out BGP Peer. The value must be between 1 and 4294967295. Providing an empty string will remove the O(local_asn="") from the L3Out BGP Peer.

options.name: local_asn_config
options.description: The configuration for local ASN of the L3Out BGP Peer.

options.name: login_domain
options.description: The login domain name to use for authentication. The default value is Local. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_LOGIN_DOMAIN) will be used instead. When using a HTTPAPI connection plugin the inventory variable C(ansible_httpapi_login_domain) will be used if this attribute is not specified.

options.name: node_group
options.description: The name of the Node Group Policy.

options.name: node_id
options.description: The ID of the node (border leaf switch).

options.name: output_level
options.description: Influence the output of this MSO module. C(normal) means the standard output, incl. C(current) dict C(info) adds informational output, incl. C(previous), C(proposed) and C(sent) dicts C(debug) adds debugging output, incl. C(filter_string), C(method), C(response), C(status) and C(url) information If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_OUTPUT_LEVEL) will be used instead.

options.name: parent_type
options.description: The parent type of the L3Out.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to use for authentication. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variables C(MSO_PASSWORD) or C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: path
options.description: The path of the interface. The path must be an existing physical port (eg. eth1/1).

options.name: peer_controls
options.description: The Peer control settings for the BGP peer.

options.name: peer_prefix
options.description: The name of the peer prefix. Providing an empty dictionary will remove the O(peer_prefix={}) from the L3Out BGP Peer. This parameter can be used instead of O(peer_prefix_uuid).

options.name: peer_prefix_uuid
options.description: The UUID of the peer prefix. Providing an empty string will remove the O(peer_prefix_uuid="") from the L3Out BGP Peer. This parameter can be used instead of O(peer_prefix).

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used for the REST connection. The default value depends on parameter `use_ssl`. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: port_channel
options.description: The port channel details.

options.name: private_as_controls
options.description: The private AS control settings for the BGP peer.

options.name: remote_asn
options.description: The remote autonomous system number (ASN) of the L3Out BGP Peer. The value must be between 1 and 4294967295. Providing an empty string will remove the O(remote_asn="") from the L3Out BGP Peer.

options.name: site_of_origin
options.description: The site of origin for the L3Out BGP Peer. The value must adhere to the pattern "extended:as2-nn2:1000:65534".

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(absent) for removing. Use C(query) for listing an object or multiple objects. Use C(present) for creating or updating.

options.name: template
options.description: The name of the L3Out template. This parameter or O(template_id) is required.

options.name: template_id
options.description: The ID of the L3Out template. This parameter or O(template) is required.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds. The default value is 30 seconds. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_TIMEOUT) will be used instead.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(false), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_USE_PROXY) will be used instead. The default is C(true).

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(false), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_USE_SSL) will be used instead. When using a HTTPAPI connection plugin the inventory variable C(ansible_httpapi_use_ssl) will be used if this attribute is not specified. The default is C(false) when using a HTTPAPI connection plugin (mso or nd) and C(true) when using the legacy connection method (only for mso).

options.name: username
options.description: The username to use for authentication. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variables C(MSO_USERNAME) or C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(false) when used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead. The default is C(true).

options.name: virtual_port_channel
options.description: The virtual port channel details.

options.name: weight
options.description: The weight of the L3Out BGP Peer. The value must be between 1 and 65535. Providing an empty string will remove the O(weight="") from the L3Out BGP Peer.
